blocks.value: The Candlestick Chart is the most popular chart used by traders and investors around the world. It provides the same information as a Bar Chart but is much easier to read.
Imagine This: Think of a candle with a body and a wick. The candle's body tells most of the story, while the wick shows how far prices travelled during the day.
Each candlestick represents one trading period and shows four prices: Open, High, Low and Close. The color of the candle quickly tells whether buyers or sellers were stronger.
If a stock opens at ₹500 and closes at ₹520, the candle usually appears green, showing that buyers pushed the price higher.
Most professional traders use candlestick charts because they provide maximum information in a simple visual format.

blocks.question: Why are Candlestick Charts so popular?
choices: They clearly show Open, High, Low and Close prices in an easy-to-read format.
They predict future prices with certainty.
